text: A man has mass 80 kg. He runs along a horizontal road against a constant resistance force of
magnitude P N. The total work done by the man in increasing his speed from 4 m s to 5.5 m s
while running a distance of 60 metres is 1200 J. Find the value of P. [4]
A train of mass 240 000 kg travels up a slope inclined at an angle of 4Å to the horizontal. There is a
constant resistance of magnitude 18 000 N acting on the train. At an instant when the speed of the
train is 15 m s its deceleration is 0.2 m s . Find the power of the engine of the train. [4]

A particle P moves in a straight line ABCD with constant acceleration. The distances AB and BC are
100 m and 148 m respectively. The particle takes 4 s to travel from A to B and also takes 4 s to travel

A particle of mass 20 kg is on a rough plane inclined at an angle of 60Å to the horizontal. Equilibrium
is maintained by a force of magnitude P N acting on the particle, in a direction parallel to a line of
greatest slope of the plane. The greatest possible value of P is twice the least possible value of P.
Find the value of the coefficient of friction between the particle and the plane. [7]
